description: Update issue status, title, description, severity, type, assignee, or ignored state. Only supplied fields change. Use null to unassign and ignored=false to restore. Accepts UUID or display id. Status verified does not run a verification scan. Use verify_issue to check a deployed fix, then inspect its evidence before deciding whether to change status.

assigneeId.description: Teammate userId from list_project_members, or null to unassign

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

description.description: Replacement description, or empty to clear

ignored.description: Ignore (true) or restore (false), without changing status

issueId.description: Issue UUID or display id such as OQ-12

status.description: New status; marking verified records a status, it does not run verification

name: update_issue
